title: Nat Kobitz as Coulthart's original Navy source

tellings.quote: Uh you know, Nat Kobitz, who was a, you know, a senior Navy scientist who was kind of Ross Coldart's original source that really brought him down the rabbit hole.

plain: A senior Navy scientist named Nat Kobitz is said to have been the first insider source of the journalist Ross Coulthart, the person who "really brought him down the rabbit hole" of UFO secrets. Michels mentions this himself, without naming where he learned it, while talking about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, and it matters because it would mean Coulthart's reporting began with a figure from inside the Navy's own science world.
